headline: Kuura Strand and Nevish Line Ignite as Base Turnover Rebounds
war_summary: Base turnover intensified sharply across the northern sectors over the past three hours, led by a violent resurgence in Kuura Strand, where ten base transfers occurred in the latest two-hour window across contested positions including Menneen and Faden Point. Nevish Line erupted into ferocious combat around Tomb Father, logging three base exchanges and over twenty-five hundred combined casualties in two hours. Weathered Expanse and Marban Hollow sustained steady tactical friction, recording six base events between them while Weathered Expanse absorbed more than twenty-one hundred casualties in the recent period. Conversely, earlier offensive thrusts along Farranac Coast and Dead Lands subsided into quieter holding actions marked by sharply declining casualty rates and stable lines. In Linn of Mercy and Callahan's Passage, attritional clashes mounted heavy tolls without producing fresh shifts in base ownership, keeping both sectors locked in place.
